principle: Use a benchmark that matches each Korean sector's listing market and size profile.

sector_construction.Korean autos: 091180.KS sector ETF plus Hyundai Motor, Kia and Hyundai Mobis breadth
sector_construction.Korean memory large caps: median of Samsung Electronics and SK hynix; no broad semiconductor ETF substitution
sector_construction.Korean semiconductor equipment, material: median of eight KOSDAQ semiconductor equipment and parts stocks

followup_policy: Persist each sector's benchmark symbol and reuse it for immediate, 30-minute and close follow-ups.
compatibility: Only an already-open legacy event may finish against ^KS11; all new events use market-specific benchmarks.
